reason: PR-11.5 fixes MF-5 by preventing skill provider_metadata from carrying authority fields while preserving the existing checks that skill metadata/body cannot claim canonical authority.
user_intent_alignment_summary: The user requested provider_metadata containment without adding product scope. This edit keeps provider-specific data opaque and non-authoritative at the edge.
diff_review_summary: The forbidden core key set was expanded to controlled reason/model/connector/approval authority names, and the guard now delegates provider_metadata shape/key validation to the shared trust_surface validator.
why_merge_not_sufficient: The old guard only checked top-level skill metadata keys and body text. It had to be extended to inspect provider_metadata itself.
replacement_justification: Without this extension, provider_metadata could remain a latent side door for route, event, trust, admission, model-policy, or connector-authority fields.
alternatives_considered: Leave provider_metadata unbounded. Rejected by MF-5.
Remove provider_metadata entirely. Rejected because Claude-ready and future provider fixtures still need bounded opaque external refs.
approver: Lowell Wong requested PR-11.5 pre-push governance hardening
removed_content_summary: No intentional authority check was removed; provider_metadata validation was added and the forbidden key set broadened.
